Remarks

Provides ready-to-use PatternStringConverter instances for common Brazilian document formats.

Properties

Cep

Converter for CEP (postal code) in format NNNNN-NNN.

public static PatternStringConverter Cep { get; }

Property Value

PatternStringConverter

Examples

01310-100

Cnpj

Converter for CNPJ (corporate taxpayer ID) in format AA.AAA.AAA/AAAA-NN. Supports the new RFB alphanumeric format (uppercase A–Z and 0–9 in positions 1–12) while remaining compatible with legacy numeric CNPJs.

public static PatternStringConverter Cnpj { get; }

Property Value

PatternStringConverter

Examples

12.345.678/0001-90 or 12.ABC.345/01DE-35

Cpf
